benchmark.name: DeepSWE v1.1

summary.en: DeepSWE v1.1 measures long-horizon software-engineering agents on repository-level tasks under a fixed mini-SWE-agent setup.
summary.zh: DeepSWE v1.1 在固定的 mini-SWE-agent 设置下，评估 agent 完成 repository-level、长链 software-engineering task 的能力。

task_format.en: The agent inspects a repository, plans and edits multiple files, runs tests, and submits a patch for an issue-level task.
task_format.zh: agent 需要检查代码仓库、规划并修改多个文件、运行测试，然后为 issue-level task 提交 patch。

explanation.en: Pass@1 is the fraction of repository tasks whose submitted patch is accepted by the benchmark grader in one run. Pass@4 is retained as a separate field and is not mixed into the headline metric.
explanation.zh: Pass@1 是一次运行中提交的 patch 被 benchmark grader 接受的 repository task 占比。Pass@4 作为独立字段保留，不和 headline metric 混合。

observations.evaluation_protocol: DeepSWE leaderboard export; only Pass@1 rows are used for the capability frontier. Harness and reasoning effort remain part of observation provenance.
observations.date_notes: A score-publication date is not present in the source export.
observations.eligibility_reason: Capability eligibility uses the dated curated observation and canonical protocol; reported-result eligibility requires result_public_date.
observations.notes: Operational evaluation timeline only; not a historical public-result date.

unavailable: T80: not included in the first vertical slice
benchmark.date_policy: Primary lifecycle time uses the earliest available date among evaluation/run time, model release time, and the earliest recorded score-publication time for the same observation. Plot dates and T50/T80/T90 are clipped at benchmark release, so lifecycle durations are never negative; original dates remain preserved for provenance.

test-of-time.rule: T50 >= 12 months OR T90 >= 24 months, including censoring

still-frontier.rule: right-censored T50 AND normalized progress < 50% AND coverage not low

recently-saturated.rule: T90 crossing within 3 months of snapshot
